# Redressal — Student Grievance & Review Portal

## Overview
Redressal is a full-stack web application designed for collegiate campuses to streamline student complaint registration, departmental routing, resolution workflows, and institutional accountability.

## Architecture
- **Frontend**: React 18, Vite, React Router v6, Tailwind CSS ("Obsidian Glass" design system)
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express REST API
- **Database**: SQLite with WAL journal mode (node:sqlite DatabaseSync)
- **Authentication**: JWT token with bcrypt password hashing
- **File Attachments**: Multer (images and PDFs up to 5MB)

## User Roles & Purviews
- **Student**: File tickets, attach evidence, monitor live status updates, view official administrative responses.
- **HOD (Head of Department)**: Academic & curriculum matters, faculty teaching, examination inquiries.
- **Proctor**: Disciplinary concerns, safety incidents, anti-ragging, campus conduct.
- **Warden**: Hostel room amenities, cleanliness, dining mess quality.
- **Maintenance / Repairman**: Infrastructure, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, lab fixtures.
- **Dean / Admin**: Campus-wide executive analytics, unassigned ticket escalation, system administration.

## Grievance Lifecycle
`submitted` -> `in_review` -> `resolved` / `rejected`

## Key REST API Endpoints
- `POST /api/auth/register`: Create student or staff account
- `POST /api/auth/login`: Authenticate and receive JWT
- `GET /api/auth/staff`: Retrieve list of departmental staff
- `POST /api/complaints`: Submit new grievance with multipart attachment
- `GET /api/complaints`: Query grievances with role purview and status filters
- `PATCH /api/complaints/:id`: Update ticket status, responder notes, and assignment
- `GET /api/complaints/stats/summary`: Aggregate counts and average resolution metrics
